story.title: The Little Plant
story.setting: A small sunlit back garden with green lawn, wooden fence and terracotta pots, soft warm late-afternoon light, realistic live-action film look.

subjects.words: A woman in her late twenties with shoulder-length dark curly hair, wearing a grey knit sweater
A man in his fifties with short silver-grey hair and grey stubble, wearing a grey t-shirt
An empty terracotta flowerpot filled with dark soil on a wooden garden table

beats.text: Medium close shot: the woman stands at the garden table and looks down, disappointed, at the empty terracotta flowerpot.
The man walks up beside her with one hand behind his back, then smiles and reveals a small potted plant with pink flowers from behind his back; her face brightens.
Together they set the flowering plant into the terracotta pot, press the soil with their hands, then look at each other and smile warmly.
